name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-science
description: Science texts in your memory, by field: physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, astronomy and the history of science. Pick an OpenStax textbook (licence per book), Wikipedia pages by category in English, French or Spanish (CC BY-SA 4.0), PlanetMath (CC BY-SA 3.0), MacTutor biographies (CC BY-SA 4.0), OEIS sequences (CC BY-SA 4.0) or arXiv abstracts (licence per article): MnemoScience downloads the texts, keeps a copy in your knowledge folder and writes them into one memory pack per field, each memory closed by a line naming its source, date and licence.

Pick an OpenStax textbook (licence per book), Wikipedia pages by category in English, French or Spanish (CC BY-SA 4.0), PlanetMath (CC BY-SA 3.0), MacTutor biographies (CC BY-SA 4.0), OEIS sequences (CC BY-SA 4.0) or arXiv abstracts (licence per article): MnemoScience downloads the texts, keeps a copy in your knowledge folder and writes them into one memory pack per field, each memory closed by a line naming its source, date and licence.
descriptionI18n.fr: Des textes de science dans ta mémoire, par domaine : physique, chimie, biologie, mathématiques, astronomie et histoire des sciences. Choisis un manuel OpenStax (licence propre à chaque livre), des pages Wikipédia par catégorie en anglais, français ou espagnol (CC BY-SA 4.0), PlanetMath (CC BY-SA 3.0), les biographies de MacTutor (CC BY-SA 4.0), des suites de l'OEIS (CC BY-SA 4.0) ou des résumés arXiv (licence par article) : MnemoScience télécharge les textes, en garde une copie dans ton dossier des connaissances et les écrit dans un pack de mémoire par domaine, chaque mémoire finissant par une ligne qui nomme sa source, sa date et sa licence.
descriptionI18n.es: Textos de ciencia en tu memoria, por campo: física, química, biología, matemáticas, astronomía e historia de la ciencia. Elige un libro de texto OpenStax (licencia propia de cada libro), páginas de Wikipedia por categoría en inglés, francés o español (CC BY-SA 4.0), PlanetMath (CC BY-SA 3.0), las biografías de MacTutor (CC BY-SA 4.0), sucesiones de la OEIS (CC BY-SA 4.0) o resúmenes de arXiv (licencia por artículo): MnemoScience descarga los textos, guarda una copia en tu carpeta de conocimientos y los escribe en un paquete de memoria por campo; cada recuerdo termina con una línea que nombra su fuente, su fecha y su licencia.

agentActions.summary: Say what MnemoScience shows and holds: the screen, the import running, and every list already in memory
agentActions.details: inMemory has one line per list put in memory (a book, a Wikipedia category, an arXiv feed, single entries): entries in the vault, refused by the source, failed, and where a long run stopped. It is null while the library is not read.

agentActions.summary: List the science fields and their sources (OpenStax books, Wikipedia, PlanetMath, MacTutor, OEIS, arXiv), with licences, sizes and what is in memory
Show a field or one source's screen, as a click on its tile does; with neither, the home screen
agentActions.details: The person picks entries and presses Add on the source's screen: importing is theirs here.

source.description: The source as the person names it (« Wikipédia », « le manuel d'astronomie », « Calculus volume 2 », « MacTutor », « OEIS ») or its id from sources (openstax:astronomy-2e, wikipedia:physics). Looked up in field, else in the field on screen, else everywhere

agentActions.summary: Go one screen up, as the Back link does: a source to its field, a field to the home screen
Open a source's own website in the browser, as its « site » link does; with no source, the one on screen

source.description: The source as the person names it (« OEIS », « MacTutor », « Wikipédia ») or its id

agentActions.summary: Stop the import running, as the Stop button does; what reached memory stays and the run resumes where it stopped

agentGuide: Name a source the way the person says it (« Wikipédia », « le manuel d'astronomie », « Calculus volume 2 », « les biographies de MacTutor », « les suites de l'OEIS »): open finds it by its words, in the field asked, else the field on screen, and an id still works. Several matches are refused AMBIGUOUS with their names and ids: pick one and call open again with the id.
A field (« la physique », « les maths », « l'histoire des sciences ») is open's field, always in English: physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, astronomy, history.
To move: open (a field, a source, or the home screen with neither), back (one screen up), openSite (the source's own website in the browser).
Putting texts in memory is the person's: open the source, they pick the entries and press Add. stop stops the import running. What is already in memory: status.
